select dd.d_moy as month,
       sum(sr.sr_return_quantity) as ret_qty,
       sum(ss.ss_quantity) as sold_qty,
       round(sum(sr.sr_return_quantity)::numeric / nullif(sum(ss.ss_quantity),0), 6) as return_rate
from store_returns sr

with sales as (
  select dd.d_moy as m, sum(ss.ss_quantity) as sold_qty, sum(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) as sold_amt
  from store_sales ss join date_dim dd on dd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  where dd.d_year = 2001
  group by dd.d_moy
),
rets as (
  select dd.d_moy as m, sum(sr.sr_return_quantity) as ret_qty, sum(sr.sr_return_amt) as ret_amt
  from store_returns sr join date_dim dd on dd.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
  where sr.sr_source='primary' and dd.d_year = 2001
  group by dd.d_moy
)
select s.m as month,
       round(r.ret_qty::numeric / nullif(s.sold_qty,0), 6) as qty_rate,
       round(r.ret_amt::numeric / nullif(s.sold_amt,0), 6) as amt_rate
from sales s join rets r on r.m = s.m
order by s.m;
